description:
We're building safety-enhancing technology for aviation that will save lives. Automated aviation systems will enable a future where air transportation is safer, more convenient and fundamentally transformative to the way goods — and eventually people — move around the planet. We are a team of mission-driven engineers with experience across aerospace, robotics and self-driving cars working to make this future a reality.

 

As an Embedded Software Engineer at Reliable Robotics, you will be a part of the Embedded Systems team developing the embedded software for our next-generation Radar system. Phased array radar systems have historically been reserved for specialized applications, but we’re making this technology affordable to enable Detect and Avoid for widespread commercial applications. Your contributions will directly enable aircraft product demonstrations, unlock the development of higher-level capabilities, and set the stage for product certification, and delivery to market.

 

Responsibilities

 - Develop C++ flight software requirements, design, code, unit tests, and requirements-based test cases in accordance with DO-178C software development procedures

 - Develop Python-based software integration test cases

 - Focus areas include, numerical optimization, networking, protocol drivers, memory interfaces, and software-to-FPGA interface layer

 

Basic Success Criteria

 - Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, or equivalent experience

 - 3+ years of experience developing C or C++

 - 3+ years of experience translating/optimizing complex mathematical algorithms into performant, deterministic embedded code

 - Hands-on experience developing driver-level software for software-to-FPGA interfaces  and managing high-bandwidth data pipelines

 

Preferred Criteria

 - 6+ years of professional experience developing C or C++

 - Hands-on experience with Radar algorithms, radar signal processing, integration, and test of a radar system

 - Experience working in a DO-178 software development environment

 - Thorough understanding of computer architecture, operating systems, and networking

 - Comfortable with a fast-paced, agile/iterative development life cycle

 

Embedded software engineers at Reliable Robotics have a unique opportunity to develop an end-to-end product from bare metal up to the aircraft level, with a direct impact on aircraft capabilities. We are a fast-paced team that gets results, and with your experience, motivation, skills, and enthusiasm, you'll help the team accomplish amazing things.
